  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           The following two documents are in my corpus with a query:  
  
  Document 1: "Taj Mahal is a beautiful monument."  
  A)      Document 2: "Victoria Memorial is also a monument."  
  Document 3: "I like to visit Agra."  
  (5)  
  Query: "taj mahal agra"  
  
  Construct a Document Term Matrix (DTM) with TF-IDF values of each term and rank  
  the documents based on the cosine similarity obtained between the query and  
  documents.  
  
  B)      We have a two-word query. For one term, the postings list consists of the following 17  
  entries:  
  [13, 15, 19, 115, 124, 139, 160, 168, 175, 181, 184, 189, 192, 196, 197, 1100, 1115]  
  For the other it is the one-entry postings list:  
  [189]  
  Work out how many comparisons would be done to intersect the two postings list with  
  the following two strategies. Briefly justify your answers:                                (3)  
  
  1. Using standard postings list.  
  2. Using postings lists with skip pointers, with a skip length of   , where p is the  
  length of the postings list.

  2)        The following three documents are in my corpus with a query:  
  
  Document 1: "Obama rejects allegations about his own bad health."  
  A)   Document 2: "The plan is to visit Obama."  
  Document 3: "Obama raises concerns with US health plan reforms."                             (5)  
  
  Query: "Obama health plan"  
  
  Estimate the probability that the above documents are relevant to the query.  
  
  B)   Draw the inverted index that would be built for the following document collection.  
  
  Document 1: "new home sales top forecasts."  
  Document 2: "home sales rise in July."                                                       (3)  
  Document 3: "increase in home sales in July."  
  Document 4: "July new home sales rise."  
  
  C)   When using weighted zone scoring, is it necessary for all zones to use the same Boolean  
  match function? Justify.                                                                (2)  
  
  3)        Consider that there are 8,00,000 documents, and each docID of the postings list is of size  
  32 bits.  
  
  A)      1. What is the basic compressed bit size for storing docID in the postings list? (1M)  
  2. Is it possible to reduce it further? (1M)                                              (5)  
  3. Illustrate the concept of variable length encoding for the docIDs < 283047,  
  283154, 283159, 283202> (3M)  
  
  
  B)   Compute the singular value decomposition of a given matrix of rank 2.
